messages.content_text:
june 12 Notes:


Today I made a bit of a mistake trading because I was only $75 away from passing my account and I took two trades that I shouldn’t have taken just because I was trying to catch small scalps to pass.
,
The first trade I took had a very solid entry trigger, a 15/30min rb that aligned perfectly with midnight open, but this trade was missing key aspects: A high time frame pd array that was rejected, and a dol. I just entered because thought I would get the 8pt reaction I needed from this strong entry trigger, but I unfortunately learned my lesson and took a small loss. (Screenshot 1)
,
I then waited for the high to get swept and we made a 5min rb. I again thought I could get the small reaction that I needed, but I was unfortunately wrong. This trade was extremely forced and I definitely shouldn’t have taken it. (Screenshot 2)
,
The one good thing about today is that I am now not in this awkward place where I am $75 away from passing, now I am $300 and need to take a decent trade. What I will do going forward is just treat this account like a live account and as if there is no profit target. I’ll go for a. full sized win, and I will trail aggressively to the needed profit target. That will be better on my psychology. I did make a mistake today, but it is kind of reasonable being in the position I am in. The important thing is that I didn’t go too far and stayed within my loss parameter and also I will learn from my lesson and not make the same mistake again.
,
As per ny session, we got a nice 10:00 setup. Before 10:00 we swept london lows and then made a range where 10:00 fell into the ote of the range. We traded back into it and 10:00 gave a perfect bottom tick reaction. What an amazing model this 10:00 setup is; it gives beautiful setups all week long. (Screenshot 3)
,

DAY 14  : 3 TRADES 3 WINS

TECHNICAL
First trade was through ES, 15 min OB tap, OTE entry,  SMT at highs. Should have waited for a breaker formation. Would have guarantee'd security. Scaled out at 7R and edged SL to recent 1min swing high. price retraced and stopped me at roughly 6.5R

Second trade was after on NQ, tapped a 1min OB/FVG at OTE, scaled into 15 sec for breaker entry, price closed above and i put my entry where the fair value gap and breaker aligned. price pulled back, tapped me in and immediately shot into TP before i could even move my TP. great execution

Third trade was another retracement from the bullish leg. another 1 min breaker was created and aligned with a 1 min FVG as well as the 5/15 min. i put my stop below the breaker and FVG and it was just enough to where my SL got edged and it chopped around. I didn't realize it was because a 15 min Bearish RB was created. So that trade was actually more risky than i anticipated. luckily a 4HR RB was holding it down. Still, i was entering within a range and it wasn't ideal. i pulled to BE the moment i saw the RB being hit. there was relative equal highs left so it gave me more confidence that price would go higher. Good adaptation to worse conditions. Good risk management.

Psychological Analysis
Was quite tilted from today, lost 4 of my last accounts to a stupid rule. just hail mary traded 2 accounts to be blown. then somewhat collected myself and saw an OTE trade, lucky that it played out honestly. it wasn't in good habits to try that. was getting nervous about being BE again so i scaled out. was satisfied with that win, then second trade played out instantly so i was quite happy about it. Third trade was risky but played out so i was quite happy about that too. now my account has been passed. thank you god. and i'm quite relieved that my losing streak ended there. i'm getting more confident in implementing this MMXM.

6/12/26
Feeling extra tired today, just want to finish this week green with an A graded day. Hit my minimums and call it.

As we open up we sell off towards internal low. I'm looking for a sweep of this sellside setting a bullish SMT to see if we can take higher. We soup into this 5m. I try longs a couple times with tight stops, they dont work. We fill the 5m in completely where I retry the longs again targetting internal liquidity of this first presented 1m FVG. I recover my losses on both accounts and also giving me my green days. Feeling a little off mentally and tired I did want to trade again but I did lock myself out. I took one trade on one of the accounts, which was a good setup but realizing I should probably lock out I just closed the trade and locked up to finish my week green. Will be looking at another account maybe come monday but im just not there mentally.

june 11 Notes:


I took a max size win today on the funded wich was nice because it felt good for my confidence especially after the past week. I also haven’t taken a winning trade for 3 weeks, so it is good to be back in the winning column.
,
We had an smt with previous day lows during asia session and we rallied from there until new york where I was watching a 4h rb to get tapped and maybe trade lower. The 4h rb lined up with the htf 0.79 and off of 9:30 open we pushed higher towards my level. TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
We looked overall bearish after 6:45, price tapped 4H RB and it was in OTE and aligned with 15 min FVG. found SMT and went with ES as it was the weaker pair. the breaker aligned with 10am KO. which in hindsight, i should have set my entry there.  set a limit on the breaker which aligned with 0.62, stop above breaker. got tapped in, andprice delivered to -2.25 and retraced and stopped me out. i was convinced that price would deliver to the -4 range because of the REL on NQ, but i was wrong. There was a 4H RB on ES's side that i missed. should have had my eyes more open on that possibility. was only looking for external liquidity draws. If the stop wasn't so big i would have just targeted -2, which in hindsight would have been the perfect trade. it seems that this execution has cost me a win. 

Psychological Analysis
This was the most promising trade and also the most frustrating one i've had so far. I had a possible clear TP, with 1200 which would have put me positive for the first time in forever. I opted to just go to -4. Would this be greed? It seemed quite fair to me. After seeing this, i was quite frustrated. I'm still frustrated as i'm writing this. I had my hopes up that this will be my first winning trade, but nope. Even pissed me off more that one apex account got liquidated for no reason. i luckily know not to revenge trade after shit like this. Its just so aggravating. today felt like the perfect day to turn around my losing streak and i just got the finger from price. (edited)
